title: Compare DLT Table Types
description: Fill in the blanks to distinguish between STREAMING TABLE, MATERIALIZED VIEW, and LIVE TABLE in Delta Live Tables. Know when to use each type.
hints: STREAMING TABLE continuously ingests from external sources
MATERIALIZED VIEW is pre-computed and refreshed on schedule
LIVE TABLE updates in real-time as source data changes
explanation: DLT offers three table types: STREAMING TABLE continuously ingests from cloud files (Auto Loader). MATERIALIZED VIEW recomputes on refresh - ideal for complex aggregations. LIVE TABLE (formerly Streaming Table) updates in real-time. Choose based on latency needs and query complexity.
